rule: E121 (2026-10-27): a prop seen in many shots holds one look the way a character does: its look and exclusion sentences word for word (plan_check.PROPS) AND its approved reference images. genesis-09's 64 Pavo stills carried the ark's two sentences word for word and still drew a tower at one end, a gabled barn or a ship's curved bow from shot to shot. A still whose prompt names a prop is made only with every approved reference of that prop (props.py, plan_check.prop_references; STILL_PROP_UNREFERENCED). A prop is APPROVED only when Claude kept an image for every view (props.py approve, by PR).
